run_convert_weights: run the python module to convert a PyTorch checkpoint by renaming state dict keys and saving the output
run_main_function: run the main function with a source .pt file path to convert model weights to a new naming convention
convert_teacher_keys: convert a checkpoint by filtering out teacher keys and renaming backbone and transformer keys
convert_mlp_keys: convert MLP layer keys from fc1 fc2 naming to layers.0 layers.1 naming convention
convert_backbone_keys: convert backbone and maskmem_backbone keys to image_encoder and memory_encoder naming convention
